findings.message: the file ends inside its list of flower droppers: the original keeps the complete records it read, goes on to read the places that were never filled, and leaves the number of eggs each team starts with to chance
the description is 30 bytes long: at most 29 fit, because the original reads 30 bytes and a text needs a zero byte at its end (a letter outside a to z takes 2 or 3 bytes)
one cell uses a tile that the dictionary names "." (row 0, column 30: tile 88): the original does not load its picture, so it does not draw it
